title: Exact-job build observations
boundary: Observation is not admission. Platform, tests, code signatures and workflow closure remain unassessed; trusted-controller collection and C3 remain blocked. The existing build matrix is unchanged.
loginRequired: Sign in with a company administrator session to view or request observations.
readError: Observations could not be read. Previously displayed evidence is hidden.
disabled: Build observation is disabled by the operator.
unavailable: No operator profile matches the current delivery, pipeline, manifest and credential.
pending: Request in progress. Do not start a replacement request.
uncertain: The response is unconfirmed. Keep this request ID and read its outcome before any retry; do not create a replacement request.
historical: Historical evidence only. Local currentness is not a fresh remote check or release permission.

state.running: Server request is still running. Read its outcome manually.
state.retryable: The server permits an explicit retry of this same request.
state.terminal: This request is complete and cannot be retried.
state.interrupted: This request was interrupted and is no longer retryable.

currentness.local_current: Local binding still matches; admission remains blocked.
currentness.stale: Local binding or verification freshness is stale.
currentness.unknown: Current local validity could not be established.

provenance.rejected: Provenance did not satisfy the verification policy.
provenance.verified_claim: Cryptographic claim verified against policy; workflow closure is not independently proven.
